name: standing alternate arms circling
description: Big alternating arm circles that warm up the shoulder joints and loosen the upper back before pressing or pulling work.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging at your sides.
Swing one arm forward, up and back in a large smooth circle.
As that arm finishes, start the same circle with the other arm.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.
Continue alternating for 20-30 seconds, then reverse the direction.
